dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body envelope from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A minor indentation is visible on the right lateral margin toward the posterior end; otherwise, margins appear smooth and continuous.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; very high pixel intensity observed across the majority of the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density; faint greyish pixel clusters are localized primarily along a narrow longitudinal mid-line.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the primary white skin and the slightly darker central longitudinal feature.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, narrow longitudinal dark-pixel line is visible along the dorsal mid-line.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A thin, linear topological depression is visible along the central dorsal axis, creating a subtle shadow-casting effect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent longitudinal linear mark or ridge extending vertically through the center of the dorsal surface.
